tasks.title: Implement bounded read-only inquiry cache and incremental refresh
tasks.objective: Implement one global cache/log of the last 50 answered inquiries across trusted callers/profiles; exact identity is original literal question, mode, selected skill and project/authority context, not principal/profile. Enforce caller project/source allowlists and private-hint-derived answer access. Preserve stale incremental refresh, top-five lexical retrieval, two execution slots plus four waiting, 30s foreground and 300s lifetime; validate and deploy paired observer runtime.
tasks.next_action: Implement assigned scoped changes with Codex subagents, root integration and acceptance.
